FN-M86Q11-1
FISCAL NOTE
Senate Bill 210
Committee: Healthcare Sponsor: Senator Dan Roberts
Analyst: Tiffany Weaver Date: 04/24/2023
Senate Bill 210 as introduced could increase the administrative obligations of the Board of
Dental Examiners of Alabama to adopt rules, pursuant to the provisions of this bill, that would
regulate the provision of teledentistry by dentists.
